view_prompts.name: 01-curto-classico
view_prompts.prompt: Create a production registration sprite sheet for the EXACT approved male hairstyle in Image 1, preserving its recognizable cut, silhouette character, locks and brown cel shading. Image 2 gives the game's 2D inked cel-shaded anatomy style, not a body to reproduce. SIX equally spaced cells in a strict 3 columns by 2 rows, in this EXACT order: top-left front facing viewer; top-middle three-quarter face pointing RIGHT; top-right strict side profile facing RIGHT; bottom-left rear three-quarter viewed from behind with face direction RIGHT; bottom-middle straight rear/back of head; bottom-right top of head viewed downwards (bowing view). Same haircut, same head anatomical scale in every view. Single bald FEATURELESS bright saturated CYAN (#00FFFF) mannequin head in each cell UNDER the brown hair, with cyan ears and a very short cyan neck. Mannequin is ONLY a registration shape: completely flat cyan, no skin tones, no face features, no cyan shading. Hair fits naturally tightly on this cyan scalp. These cyan registration heads will be removed to obtain separate reusable hair overlays. Rear view fully covers the upper back of the head with hair; distinct rear lock structure and natural hairline/nape; rear-three-quarter has mostly back of hair with cyan ear exposed. Profile does not resemble front view. Top view has hair crown with whorl and no face. Adult male anatomical oval head, modest volume, shoulderless. ALL hair fully inside cell with generous transparent margin; no detached flecks. Warm upper-left light, clean thin dark ink contour and confident broad shade masses matching the approved asset. Genuine transparent background outside figures, no brown haze/glow, no shadows on transparent areas. No text, no labels, no outlines around cells, no grid, no bodies, no clothes, no 3D, no photorealism. Do not replace with a different haircut. Hair remains natural brown in every view.
